/* V11: touch-first presentation for iPhone and Android, without altering original adventure logic. */
html { -webkit-text-size-adjust:100%; scroll-behavior:smooth; }
body { overscroll-behavior-y:contain; }
button { -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent; }
#game { -webkit-user-select:none; user-select:none; }
.touchTools { display:none; }
.touchInfo { display:none; }
.touchActions { display:none; }
.gameFocus .sceneTag small { display:none; }
@media (pointer:coarse), (max-width:900px) {
  .shell {padding:0 8px calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); max-width:100%;}
  .topbar {min-height:0; padding:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 7px) 2px 7px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:stretch; gap:7px;}
  .logo {gap:8px;justify-content:space-between;}
  .logo strong {font-size:clamp(15px,4vw,20px);letter-spacing:0;}
  .logo small {font-size:8px;}
  .logoMark {width:32px;height:32px;font-size:19px;border-radius:9px;}
  .stats {display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:5px;align-items:stretch;}
  .stat {min-width:0; padding:3px 5px; border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden;}
  .stat label{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:0;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;}
  .stat b{font-size:12px;}
  .extraStat{min-width:0!important;}
  .miniMeter{margin-top:2px;}
  #soundBtn,#helpBtn{display:none;}
  .layout{display:block;}
  .viewport {width:100%;max-width:100%;min-height:0;max-height:none;aspect-ratio:4/3; border-radius:13px; box-shadow:0 9px 30px #0007;}
  .sceneTag{top:7px;left:7px;max-width:60%;}
  .sceneTag b{font-size:12px;padding:5px 7px;border-radius:7px;}
  .sceneTag small{font-size:9px;padding:3px 5px;}
  .dialog{left:1.5%;right:1.5%;bottom:1.5%;padding:10px;max-height:87%;overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;border-radius:11px;}
  .dialog p{font-size:clamp(12px,2.9vw,15px);line-height:1.35;margin:5px 0 8px;}
  .talkHeader{margin-bottom:4px;gap:8px;}.talkPortrait{width:36px;height:36px;}.talkHeader strong{font-size:14px;}
  .choices{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px;}
  .choice,.primary,.secondary,.sortChoices button,.pad button,.mapBtn{min-height:44px;touch-action:manipulation;}
  .choice{font-size:12px;padding:8px 9px;line-height:1.2;}
  .minigame{inset:2.5%;padding:12px;max-height:95%;overflow-y:auto;place-content:center;}
  .minigame h3{font-size:19px;}.minigame p{font-size:13px;}
  .overlay{padding:8px;}.splash{padding:17px 18px;border-radius:16px;max-height:100%;overflow:auto;}
  #overlay:not([hidden]){position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:calc(15px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 14px calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));max-height:100dvh;overflow-y:auto;}
  #overlay .splash{width:min(100%,500px);max-height:calc(100dvh - 48px - env(safe-area-inset-bottom));overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;}
  #overlay .splash button{min-height:46px;}
  .splash h1{font-size:clamp(28px,8vw,38px);margin:8px 0;}
  .splash p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;margin:7px 0;}
  .side {display:none;}
  .side.touchOpen {display:block;position:fixed;z-index:45;inset:auto 8px calc(62px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) 8px;max-height:min(70dvh,650px);min-height:0;box-shadow:0 0 0 100vmax #0009, 0 18px 50px #000;}
  .side.touchOpen .sideContent {max-height:calc(min(70dvh,650px) - 52px);}
  .sideTabs button{min-height:44px;padding:12px 5px;font-size:13px;}
  .bottom{margin-top:7px;padding:8px;border-radius:10px;}
  .bottomHead{margin-bottom:3px;}.bottomHead strong{font-size:10px;}.bottomHead small{font-size:10px;}
  .inventory{min-height:42px;padding:0;gap:6px;}
  .inv{min-width:85px;min-height:45px;padding:4px 5px;border-radius:8px;}
  .inv img{width:28px;height:28px;}.inv span{font-size:10px;}
  .toast{bottom:calc(70px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));font-size:13px;}
  .touchTools{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between; margin:7px 0 0;}
  .touchTools button{border-radius:10px;background:#263238;border:1px solid #ffffff36;min-height:45px; flex:1;padding:8px 4px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:#f3e9cf;}
  .touchTools button.active{background:#675632;border-color:#f0d184;}
  .touchTools button:active{background:#4c514c;}
  .touchInfo{display:block;color:#bdc8c2;margin:3px 3px 5px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.4;text-align:center;}
  .touchActions.open{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:6px 2px 8px;max-height:110px;overflow-y:auto;}
  .touchActions button{background:#293238;color:#e7e6dc;border:1px solid #ffffff38;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;min-height:42px;line-height:1.25;}
}
@media (pointer:coarse) and (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:600px) {
  body {height:100dvh;overflow:hidden;}
  .shell {display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100dvh;padding:0 calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-right)) env(safe-area-inset-bottom) calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-left));}
  .topbar {display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;flex:none; padding:2px 0;max-height:48px;}
  .logo small,.sceneTag small,.touchInfo {display:none;}
  .stats {display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:nowrap;}.stat {min-width:60px;padding:3px 5px;}
  .logo strong{font-size:13px;}.logoMark{width:24px;height:24px;font-size:13px;}
  .layout{display:flex;flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:hidden;justify-content:center;}
  .viewport {height:100%;width:auto;max-width:calc(100vw - 25px);aspect-ratio:4/3;max-height:none;border-radius:10px;}
  .bottom {display:block;position:fixed;left:calc(5px + env(safe-area-inset-left));top:53px;bottom:6px;width:max(125px,calc((100vw - min(calc((100dvh - 48px) * 4 / 3),100vw - 25px))/2 - 22px));max-width:175px;margin:0;overflow:auto;padding:8px 7px;z-index:4;background:#151e23d9;}
  .bottomHead{display:block;} .bottomHead small{display:none;} .inventory{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:4px;} .inv{width:100%;min-width:0;}
  .touchTools {display:flex;position:fixed;right:calc(4px + env(safe-area-inset-right));top:55px;bottom:auto;flex-direction:column;width:57px;z-index:4;gap:5px;}
  .touchTools button{min-height:38px;width:54px;font-size:10px;flex:auto;padding:5px 2px;}
  .touchActions.open {position:fixed;bottom:7px;left:8px;right:65px;z-index:7;background:#111c21ec;border-radius:12px;max-height:96px;}
  .side.touchOpen{inset:48px 69px 8px auto;width:min(310px,60vw);max-height:none;}
  .dialog {max-height:95%;padding:7px 9px;}
  .dialog p {font-size:12px;}
  .choice{min-height:35px;}
  .minigame{inset:2%;}
  .toast{bottom:10px;}
}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="shell">
<header class="topbar"><div class="logo"><div class="logoMark">S</div><div><strong>DE LAATSTE DRIE EURO · MOBIEL</strong><small>Een Cantique-avontuur met Sem</small></div></div><div class="stats"><div class="stat"><label>Portemonnee</label><b id="cash">€ 3</b></div><div class="stat heat"><label>Argwaan</label><b id="heat">0%</b></div><div class="stat"><label>Stress</label><b id="stress">15%</b></div><button id="soundBtn" class="tool" title="Geluid aan/uit" aria-label="Geluid aan of uit">Geluid uit</button><button id="helpBtn" class="tool" title="Speluitleg">?</button></div></header>
<div class="layout">
<main class="viewport" id="viewport"><canvas id="game" width="960" height="720" aria-label="Cantique spelwereld. Tik op de vloer om te lopen, op voorwerpen om ze te onderzoeken."></canvas><div class="sceneTag"><b id="sceneName">Cantique</b><small id="sceneSub">Een lastig dure maandag</small></div><div class="hoverLabel" id="hoverLabel"></div>
<div class="dialog" id="dialog" hidden><div class="talkHeader"><img class="talkPortrait" id="talkPortrait" alt=""><div><strong id="talkName"></strong><small id="talkRole"></small></div></div><p id="talkText"></p><div class="choices" id="choices"></div></div>
<div class="minigame" id="minigame" hidden></div>
<div class="overlay" id="overlay"><div class="splash" id="splash"><div class="eyebrow">Cantique presenteert · Point & Click Adventure</div><h1>SEM.<br><span>De laatste drie euro.</span></h1><p>Het is bijna vrijdag. Sem heeft drie euro, een duur probleem en een tas waarin verdacht veel past. In Cantique ligt apparatuur, maar er zijn ook mensen die hem willen helpen. Wat je doet, bepaalt de afloop.</p><p>Loop door de echte Cantique-ruimtes, praat met collega’s, los puzzels op, verdien geld of probeer je geluk. Alles in dit spel is fictie.</p><button id="newBtn" class="primary">Nieuw spel</button><button id="continueBtn" class="secondary" hidden>Verder spelen</button><p style="font-size:11px;color:#a5b5af;margin-bottom:0">Op iPhone: tik op de vloer om te lopen; tik op meubels, mensen en deuren voor acties. Geen toetsenbord nodig.</p></div></div>
</main>

<nav class="touchTools" aria-label="Mobiele spelbediening" id="touchTools">
<button type="button" id="touchInspect" aria-pressed="false">Bekijk</button>
<button type="button" id="touchInventory">Tas</button>
<button type="button" id="touchNotebook">Notities</button>
<button type="button" id="touchSound">Geluid</button>
<button type="button" id="touchFullscreen">Groot beeld</button>
</nav>
<div class="touchActions" id="touchActions" aria-label="Voorwerpen in deze ruimte"></div>
<p class="touchInfo" id="touchInfo">Tik op de vloer om te lopen of tik op een voorwerp. Draai je telefoon horizontaal voor groter beeld.</p>
<aside class="side"><nav class="sideTabs" aria-label="Notitieboek"><button data-tab="tasks" class="active">Opdrachten</button><button data-tab="map">Locaties</button><button data-tab="journal">Dagboek</button></nav><div class="sideContent" id="sideContent"></div></aside>
</div>
